meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 用户给出目录、网址、粘贴笔记或刚进行的对话时，Claude 会提炼出可复用的操作步骤，写成 .claude/skills/ 下的 SKILL.md；若已有相关技能，则就地改进，而不是另建。
howto.when: 当你说出“/learn”“learn this”或“turn this into a skill”等口令，或要求改进/更新已有技能时触发。

say.text: 把我们刚做过的步骤，提炼成一个技能。
say.note: 它回顾对话后生成 SKILL.md。

say.text: 把这个网址里可复用的步骤，存成一个技能。
say.note: 它读取该页面并提炼步骤。

say.text: 更新一下已有的“mysql-setup”技能，补上这次的坑。
say.note: 它在原技能文件上补充并去重。

howto.what_en: When the user supplies a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the conversation just had, Claude extracts the reusable procedure and writes it as a SKILL.md under .claude/skills/. If a skill already covers the topic, it improves that skill in place instead of creating a duplicate.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "/learn", "learn this", or "turn this into a skill", or asks to refine/update an existing skill.

say_en.text: Turn what we just did into a reusable skill.
say_en.note: It reviews the conversation and produces a SKILL.md.

say_en.text: Learn the reusable steps from this URL and save them as a skill.
say_en.note: It fetches the page and extracts the steps.

say_en.text: Update the existing 'mysql-setup' skill with this new gotcha.
say_en.note: It adds to the existing file and dedupes.
